configure_compile_flags: configure C++ compile flags for exceptions, threads, and timer support in libcxxabi tests
configure_features: configure available test features based on compiler capabilities and lit configuration options
has_cpp_feature: check if the C++ compiler supports a specific feature macro with a minimum required value
configure_compile_flags_header_includes: configure include paths for libcxx, libcxxabi, and libunwind headers in the test environment
configure_src_root: resolve and set the source root directories for libcxxabi and libcxx from lit configuration
